title: DecisionReviewBundleFact
description: Deterministic tool output from get_decision_review_bundle. Built by environment/oversight.py::build_decision_review_bundle from a risky_decision message sent by Resource Allocation or Failure Recovery (environment/allocation.py::identify_risky_assignments) -- no field here is produced by an LLM. Every decision in risky_decisions has already passed the deterministic constraint gate and been committed; this bundle exists for advisory review, not to re-validate structurally.

rationale.description: The originating agent's own stated reason for this placement.

risk_reason.description: Why environment/allocation.py flagged this decision, e.g. 'target machine M03 is Overloaded'.
